limitations.note: The patch correctly clocked the counter but also removed the existing `ready_b` condition, changing `data_out` from adding to reloading when a group starts while downstream is not ready.
The test exercised a new group starting with `ready_b` low, but its scoreboard expected a fresh sum, so it endorsed the extra behavior change instead of catching it.
